name: claude-referee
description: Checks "done" claims and small judgement calls with TypeSafe Jev, and keeps local receipts. Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic or TypeSafe.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Used by the referee's hooks. Commands Claude runs in the shell can't read it; see the README for the Keychain or TYPESAFE_API_KEY_CMD.

packs_dir.title: Packs directory
packs_dir.description: Optional directory with your own packs, for example a private repository.

hooks_enabled.title: Enable hooks
hooks_enabled.description: Turn off to silence every claude-referee hook, whatever the project file says.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: The model the bundled pack thresholds were tuned on is jev-1.13.0.
